a: मांधातृ — m. N. of a king of the solar race, son of Yuvanāśva (being born from his own belly). As soon as he came out of the belly, the sages said ‘कं एष धास्यति’; whereupon Indra came down and said ‘मां धास्यति’; the boy was, therefore, called Māndhātṛ.

m: मांश्चतु mfn. (prob.) light yellow, dun-coloured, RV. vii, 44, 3 (Padap. & Prāt. मंश्चतु)
pl. (˚चत्वास्) = अश्वाः, Naigh. i, 14.
मांश्चत्व mfn. (prob.) yellowish, RV. ix, 97, 52 (मांश्चत्व, ib. 54).

a: मांथ् — {c1c} P. (मांथति) To hurt, in jure.
मांदारः, मांदारवः — A kind of tree.
मांद्यं — [मंद-ष्यञ्] 1 Dulness, laziness, slowness, --2 Stupidity. --3 Weakness, feeble state; अग्निमांद्यं. --4 Apathy. --5 Sickness, illness, indisposition.
मांगलिक — a. (की f.) [मंगल-ठक्] 1 Auspicious, tending to good fortune, indicative of auspiciousness; मुदमस्य मांगलिकतूर्यकृतां ध्वनयः प्रतेनुरनुवप्रमपां Ki. 6. 4; Mv. 4. 35; Bv. 2. 57. --2 Fortunate.

मांगल्य — a. [मंगलाय हितं ष्यञ्] Auspicious, indicative of good fortune; Ś. 4. 4. --ल्यं 1 Auspiciousness, prosperity, welfare, good fortune. --2 A blessing or benediction. --3 A festivity, festival, any auspicious rite. --4 An auspicious thing, amulet. --Comp. --मृदंगः a drum beaten on auspicious occasions; U. 6. 25.

मांजिष्ठिक — a. (की f.) Dyed or tinged with madder; मौर्व्या मेखलया नियंत्रितमधोवासश्च मांजिष्ठिकं U. 4. 20; Mv. 1. 18.
मांक्ष् — {c1c} P. (मांक्षति) To wish or desire, long for.
मांडलिक — a. (की f.) Relating to, or ruling, a province. --कः The ruler of a province.

sarvvamAMsAdastasmAnmatsyAn vivarjjayet ॥’ iti mAnave 5 aDyAyaH ॥ anyacca । SrIBAgavatapaYcamaskanDagadyam । ‘ye tviha vE puruzAH puruzameDena yajante । yASca striyo nfpaSUn KAdanti tAMSca tASca te paSavo iha nihatA yamasadane yAtayanto rakzogaRAH । SOnikA iva suDitinA vadAyAsfka pibantIti ॥’ brahmapurARam । ‘paSostu mAryyamARasya na mAMsaM grAhayet kvacit । pfzWamAMsaM garBaSayyAM SuzkamAMsamaTApi vA ॥’ mahABAratam । ‘rogArtto'ByarTito vApi yo mAMsaM nAttyalolupaH । PalamApnotyayatnena so'SvameDaSatasya ca ॥’ nandipurARam । ‘yaScopadeSaM kurute parasya tu mahAtmanaH । mAMsasya varjjanaPalaM so'mAMsAdaPalaM laBet ॥’ BavizyapurARam । ‘AmizaM raktaSAkaYca yo BuNkte ca raverddine । saptajanma Bavet kuzWI daridraScopajAyate ॥’ vizRupurARam । caturddaSyazwamI cEva amAvAsyATa pUrRimA । parvvARyetAni rAjendra ! ravisaMkrAntireva ca ॥ strItElamAMsasaMBogI parvvasvetezu vE pumAn । viRmUtraBojanaM nAma prayAti narakaM mftaH ॥’ iti tiTyAditattvam ॥ aTa mAMsaBakzaRaviDiH । ‘SrAdDe devAn pitFn prArccya KAdan mAMsaM na dozaBAk । vaset sa narake Gore dinAni paSuromaBiH ॥ sammitAni durAcAro yo hantyaviDinA paSUn । mAMsaM saMtyajya saMprApya kAmAn yAti tato harim ॥’ iti gAruqe 96 aDyAyaH ॥ api ca । ‘goDA kUrmmaH SaSaH KaqgI SalyakaSceti sattamAH । BakzyAn paYcanaKAnnityaM manurAha prajApatiH ॥ matsyAn saSalkAn BuYjIta mAMsaM rOravameva ca । navedya devatAByaSca brAhmaReByaSca nAnyaTA ॥ mAyUraM tEttiraYcEva kapotaYca kapiYjalam । vArdDInasaM vakaM BakzyaM nIlahaMsaM parAjitAH ॥ saParaH siMhatuRqaSca taTA pAWInarohitO । matsyAstvete samuddizwA BakzaRAya tapoDanEH ॥ prokzitaM BakzayedezAM mAMsaYca dbijakAmyayA । yaTAviDiniyuktaSca prARAnAmapi cAtyaye ॥ Bakzayannapi mAMsAni SezaBojI na lipyate । OzaDArTamaSaktO vA niyogAdyajYakAraRAt ॥ Amantritastu yaH SrAdDe dEve vA mAMsamutsfjet । yAyanti paSuromARi tAvato narakAn vrajet ॥ iti kUrmmapurARe upaviBAge 16 aDyAyaH ॥ api ca । mAMsasyAtaH pravakzyAmi viDiM BakzaRavarjjane । prokzitaM BakzayenmAMsaM brAhmaRAnAYca kAmyayA ॥ yaTAviDiniyuktaScu prARAnAmeva cAtyaye । prARasTAnnamidaM sarvvaM prajApatirakalpayat ॥ sTAvaraM jaNgamaYcEva sarvvaM prARasya Bojanam । carARAmannamacarA daMzwriRAmapyadaMzwriRaH ॥ ahastASca sahastAnAM SUrARAYcEva BIravaH । nAttA duzyatyadannAdyAn prARino'hanyahanyapi ॥ DAtrEva sfzwA hyAdyASca prARinottAra eva ca । yajYAya jagDirmAMsasyetyeza dEvo viDiH smftaH ॥ ato'nyaTA pravfttistu rAkzaso viDirucyate । krItvA svayaM vApyutpAdya paropakftameva vA । devAn pitFnarccayitvA KAdan mAMsaM na duzyati ॥ niyuktastu yaTAnyAyaM yo mAMsaM nAtti mAnavaH । sa pretya paSutAM yAti samBavAnekaviMSatim ॥ na mAMsaBakzaRe dozo na madye na ca mETune । pravfttirezA BUtAnAM nivfttistu mahAPalA ॥’ iti mAnave 5 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ devIpurARam । ‘azwamIM samupozyEva navamyAmapare'hani । matsyamAMsopahAreRa dadyAnnEvedyamuttamam । tenEva viDinAnnantu svayaM BuYjIta nAnyaTA ॥ yAjYavalkyaH । ‘prARAtyaye taTA SrAdDe prokzitaM dbijakAmyayA । devAn pitFn samaByarccya KAdan mAMsaM na dozaBAk ॥’ yamaH । ‘Bakzayet prokzitaM mAMsaM sakft brAhmaRakAmyayA । dEve niyuktaH SrAdDe vA niyame ca vivarjjayet ॥’ iti tiTyAditattvam ॥ * ॥ BAktAmizaM yaTA, -- ‘govarjjyamAmizaM a: मांसं — [मन्-स दीर्घश्च Uṇ. 3. 64] 1 Flesh, meat; समांसो मधुपर्कः U. 4. (The word is thus fancifully derived in Ms. 5. 55: --पां स भक्षयिताऽपुत्र यस्य मांसमिहाद्म्यहम् . एतन्मांसस्य मांसत्वं प्रवदंति मनीषिणः ..). --2 The flesh of fish. --3 The fleshy part of a fruit. --सः 1 A worm. --2 N. of a mixed tribe, selling meat. --3 A worm. --4 Time. --Comp. --अद, --अद, --आदिन्, --भक्षक a. flesh-eating, carnivorous (as an animal); Bk. 16. 29, Ms. 5. 15. --अर्गलः, --लं a piece of flesh hanging down from the mouth. --अर्बुदः, दं a kind of disease of the membrum virile. --अशनं {1} flesh-meat. {2} flesheating. --अष्टका N. of the eighth day in the dark half of Māgha. --आहारः animal food. --इष्टा a kind of bird (वल्गुला). --उपजीविन् m. a dealer in flesh. --ओदनः {1} a meal of flesh. {2} rice boiled with flesh. --कच्छ पः a fleshy abscess on the palate. --कंदी a swelling of the flesh. --कारिन् n. blood. --ग्रंथिः a gland. --जं, --तेजस् n. fat, adeps. --तानः a polypus in the throat. --द्राविन् m. a kind of sorrel. --निर्यासः the hair of the body. --पः a Piśāca or demon. --पचनं a vessel for cooking meat. --पटकः, --कं {1} a basket of flesh. {2} a large quantity of flesh. --पित्तं a bone. --पेशी {1} a muscle. {2} a piece of flesh. {3} an epithet of the fœtus from the 8th to the 14th day. --फला the egg plant. --भेत्तृ, --भेदिन् a. cutting the flesh. --योनिः a creature of flesh and blood. --रसः soup. --लता a wrinkle. --विक्रयः sale of meat. --सारः, --स्नेहः fat. --हासा skin.

मांस—पिण्ड—गृहीत-वदन mfn. carrying a lump of fl˚ in the mouth, MW.
मांस—पित्त n. a bone, L.
मांस—पिटक m. n. a basket-full or large quantity of flesh, Hariv.
मांस—प्ररोह m. a fleshy excrescence or protuberance, Suśr.
मांस—पुष्पिका f. a species of plant, L.
मांस—रस m. fl˚-broth, Suśr.
blood, Gal.

s: strI, (mAMsaM ropayatIti । ruha + Ric + RiniH । NIp । na puk .) suganDidravyaBedaH । tatparyyAyaH । agniruhA 2 vfttA 3 carmmakazA 4 vasA 5 vikazA 6 mAMsarohI 7 । asyA guRAH । vfzyatvam । sArakatvam । dozatrayanASitvaYca । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (taTAcAsyAH paryyAyo guRASca । “mAMsarohiRyatiruhA vfttA carmmakarI kfSA । prahAravallI vikaSA vIravatyapi kaTyate ॥ syAnmAMsarohiRI vfzyA sarA dozatrayApahA ॥” iti BAvaprakASasya pUrvvaKaRqe praTame BAge ॥)
v: strI mAsaM ropayati ruha--Ric Rini vA na puk । suganDidravyaBede (cAmakazA) । rAjani॰ ।

m: मांस—रुचि m. fond of fl˚, Hit.
मांस—रुहा, मांस—रोहा, मांस—रोहिका, मांस—रोहिणी, and मांस—रोही, f. a species of fragrant plant, L.

s: puM, (mAMsasya sAraH .) medaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (mAMsezvapi sAro balaM yasya । sabalasTUlakAyaH । yaTA, bfhatsaMhitAyAm । 68 । 100 । “upacitadeho vidbAn DanI surUpaSca mAMsasAro yaH । saNGAta iti ca suSlizwasanDitAsuKaBujo jYeyAH ॥”)
m: मांस—सार m. ‘fl˚-essence’, tat, L.
blood, Gal.
मांस—सार mfn. having the fl˚ predominant (among the 7 constituent parts of the body), VarBṛS.
मांस—संघात m. swelling of the flesh.
मांस—स्नेह m. ‘fl˚-marrow’, fat, L.
मांस—तान m. a polypus in the throat, Suśr.
मांस—तस् ind. on the fleshy side (of a hide; opp. to लोम-तस्), MānŚr.
मांस—तेजस् n. ‘fl˚-marrow’, fat, L.
मांस—त्व n. the being fl˚, MBh.
the derivation of the word मांस, Mn. v, 55.
मांस—वर्षिन् mfn. raining fl˚ (i.e. locusts?), MBh.
मांस—वत् (मांस-), mfn. having or possessing fl˚, AV.
मांस—वृद्धि f. increase or growth of fl˚, Hit.

s: [n] tri, (mAMsavikrayo'syAstIti । mAMsavikrayeRa jIvati veti iniH .) AmizavikrayakarttA । iti halAyuDaH ॥ tatparyyAyaH । vEtaMsikaH 2 kOwikaH 3 mAMsikaH 4 । ityamaraH । 2 । 10 । 14 ॥ SOnikaH 5 । iti jawADaraH ॥ kOwakikaH 6 । iti SabdaratnAbalI ॥ (yaTA manO । 3 । 151 । “cikitsakAn devalakAn mAMsavikrayiRastaTA । vipaRena ca jIvanto varjyAH syurhavyakavyayoH ॥”)

m: मांस—विक्रय m. the sale of fl˚, Śukas.
मांस—विक्रयिन् (Mn.) m. a fl˚-seller (the former also used as a term of reproach).
मांस—विक्रेतृ (MBh.) m. a fl˚-seller (the former also used as a term of reproach).
मांस—विवेक m. N. of wk.
मांस—यूथ n. a quantity of fl˚, MW.
मांस—योनि m. ‘fl˚-born’, a creature of fl˚ and blood, MBh.
मांसे-पद् (strong from पाद्) m. a species of animal, Kāṭh.

v: strI mAMsamizwaM yasyAH । valgulAyAM KagaBede rAjani॰
m: मांसेष्टा f. a species of flying animal (वल्गला), L.
मांसि m. sperm
मांसि mfn. having the smell of sperm, L.
मांसिका, मांसिनी or मांसी, f. Nardostachys Jatamansi, L.

v: tri॰ mAMsaM paRyamasya Wak । mAMsavikrayopajIvini । (kasAi) amaraH ।
m: मांसिक mfn. माज्ंसाय प्रभवति, g. संतापादि
= मांसं नियुक्तं दीयते ऽस्मै, Kāś. on Pāṇ. iv, 4, 67
मांसिक m. a butcher or a seller of meat, SaddhP.

k.v: जीवान्तकः शाकुनिको द्वौ वागुरिकजालिकौ। वैतंसिकः कौटिकश्च मांसिकश्च समं त्रयम्.।

s: strI, (mAMsavat padArTo'syAmastIti । iniH । NIp .) jawAmAMsI । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥

m: मांस्ऽ-ओदन m. = मांसौदन, GṛS.
मांसोन्नति f. swelling of the flesh, Suśr.
मांसोपजीविन् m. ‘living by flesh’, a dealer in meat, R.
मांस्—पाक m. = मांस-प्˚, Kār. on Pāṇ. vi, 1, 144.
मांस्—पचन mf(ई)n. used for cooking meat (as a cauldron), RV. i, 162, 13.
मां-स्पृष्ट mfn. (= माम् अनुप्राप्त, or मया लब्ध), ŚBr., Sch.

a: मांत्रिकः — One who is conversant with charms or spells, a conjurer, sorcerer.
